top_3_findings.title: .gitignore missing .env / credentials.json / secrets.toml entries
top_3_findings.detail: The repo .gitignore (164 bytes) does not enumerate .env, credentials.json, or secrets.toml. None of these files currently exist in the working tree, so there is no active leak, but the absence creates a safety gap: a developer who creates one of these files locally could accidentally commit it. Remediation: add three lines to .gitignore before tagging.
